thread:
sam: heads-up — production latency spike on embeddings v2, small % of requests hitting 504s. I want to do a late-night cutover to the previous model shard with a fast rollback plan. need quick approvals from oncall/product.
meera: sending traces now — looks like kv-cache eviction + OOM on one pod. agree roll back shard, low blast radius.
jae (oncall): I'm up. give me the image tag and the exact rollback command. 5min safety window please.
sam: image: `redwood/embeddings:v2-20260321-7f8a` rollback command: ```kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2-20260320-4d2b && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeddings -w``` will also disable new-route flag in feature toggle: `featurectl set embeddings_route v2 false`
lee-release: pinging product for signoff @marta — we need explicit ops+product ok to bypass the usual 30m canary window.
marta: saw the dashboard. product asks: are we reverting only the model artifact and not schema? if yes, +1 from product for expedited cutover. :thumbsup:
jae (oncall): +1 from oncall conditioned on me running the rollback steps and visibility on traffic shift. I'll be ready to trigger.
ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: canary policy requires 2 checks (latency & error rate) — bypass permission requested by user `sam`.
sam: requesting bypass: reason "urgent regression, small shard, rolling back to last known-good image" — need deploy-bot expedite.
lee-release: can we set a temporary traffic-split: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: split/v1
kind: TrafficSplit
metadata:
  name: embeddings-split
spec:
  backends:
  - service: embeddings-v1
    weight: 100
EOF` — that gives immediate switch, ops aware.
marta: product confirms minimal data impact. approving expedited cutover. leaving note for release notes: "rollback model shard due to intermittent OOM under KV-cache pressure — reverted to v2-20260320-4d2b while we investigate." 
jae (oncall): I'll perform the rollout at :10 after the hour. will monitor 10m baseline + alert thresholds. if errors spike >2% I'll roll forward to v2 and open incident.
sam: deploy-bot, please escalate and run bypass and schedule at 1719998950 (in 62s). tag me and jae.
deploy-bot: [automation] Received expedited request from sam. Preconditions: all checks green? current canary metrics: latency p95 230ms (+45%), errors 0.9% (<threshold). Permission required from `marta` and `jae` to bypass canary — both provided. Executing in 60s.
ops-bot: starting pre-checks: disk/IO, pod readiness, kube-apiserver latency. all green.
(deploy window) jae (oncall): initiating image swap now. running `kubectl set image`... watching rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout event: embeddings -> image redwood/embeddings:v2-20260320-4d2b. pod 3/3 ready.
meera: observing traces and KV hit-rate. early signs: p95 down to 120ms, errors 0.2%.
jae (oncall): holding for 600s. telemetry looks stable. will mark success if no regressions.
sam: filing follow-up eval: ticket ENG-1455 with test prompts, perf diff, and todo to investigate cache eviction root cause.
lee-release: leaving release note stub: "emergency rollback: embeddings v2 reverted to last stable image to mitigate intermittent OOMs. follow-up perf investigation planned." 
marta: thanks team. approved expedited cutover and documented reason. please add postmortem if incident threshold hit.
ops-bot: monitor window complete — 10m passed, metrics stable. closing expedited cutover thread. :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks all — will open a follow-up doc for root cause and long-term mitigation.
